sla-active-0340-22-103012.summary: 20 North Central Ave in Hartsdale is Fantasy Cuisine (entity Leo Chuliya, Ltd.), an established northern/regional Chinese restaurant with its own site, a Westchester Magazine review, and 359 Yelp reviews. Established, not new — recent license activity is a renewal.
sla-active-0340-22-103012.style: Northern/regional Chinese (Sichuan-leaning), hand-made dumplings and noodles.
sla-active-0340-22-103012.menu: Soup dumplings, scallion pancakes, dry-pot dishes, salt-and-pepper chicken, shrimp with walnuts, beef & broccoli, noodles.
sla-active-0340-22-103012.angle: Specialty seafood (shrimp/prawn, dry-pot seafood) and Caputo 00 flour for hand-pulled noodles, dumpling skins, and scallion pancakes.

sla-active-0340-22-107625.summary: '1959 Foods' is the entity behind The Cube Inn, an established Cuban restaurant at 22 Main St, Tarrytown (open since Aug 2020). Long-running, so a license reference is a renewal.
sla-active-0340-22-107625.style: Cuban / Caribbean (Taino, African, Creole, Spanish influences); ~40-seat bar and restaurant, weekend brunch.
sla-active-0340-22-107625.menu: Cuban tapas, bowls, sandwiches, burgers; pork (lechon/pernil), Cuban sandwiches, ropa vieja, rice and beans, plantains, flan.
sla-active-0340-22-107625.angle: Allen Brothers beef for ropa vieja/vaca frita and burgers, specialty seafood for Caribbean dishes, Caputo flour and imported cheeses for pressed sandwiches, Valrhona/Chicoa for flan/dessert.

sla-active-0240-26-150090.summary: Vietnam's Central (licensed 'Vietnam Central TP') is an established chef-owned Vietnamese restaurant at 694 Central Park Ave, Scarsdale, with own site and 430+ Yelp reviews. Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0240-26-150090.style: Central Vietnamese; casual sit-down/takeout with catering.
sla-active-0240-26-150090.menu: Lemon fried shrimp, pot stickers, BBQ ribs, hot wings, pho, banh mi, vermicelli, rice/entree plates (pork, shrimp, catfish, chicken), curries.
sla-active-0240-26-150090.angle: Specialty seafood (shrimp, catfish, whole fish) for chili/lemon-fried dishes; premium pork/ribs and beef for pho and grilled rice plates.

sla-active-0340-26-150203.summary: 27 Mamaroneck Ave is in City Center White Plains; the address historically housed a (now closed) Applebee's and Zanaro's Italian. No currently-operating brand verified; license name mirrors the street address.
sla-active-0340-26-150203.style: Unknown / unverified. Prior tenants American casual and Italian.
sla-active-0340-26-150203.angle: If Italian, Caputo 00 flour, Teo tomatoes, Grand Reserve butter, imported cheeses; if American grill, Allen Brothers beef. Verify concept first.

sla-active-0340-26-150067.summary: Peaberry Cafe Bar & Restaurant, 1550 Central Park Ave, Yonkers - Latin-Mediterranean fusion cafe/bar with a barista coffee program. Own site and IG; scratch prep (8-hr oxtail, hand-carved chicharron, daily mezze).
sla-active-0340-26-150067.style: Latin (Dominican/Caribbean) and Mediterranean fusion; specialty coffee cafe and full bar.
sla-active-0340-26-150067.menu: Chicharron Mofongo, Mixed Meats for Two, Octopus Canoa, Rabo Oxtail Bravo, house mezze, burgers, salads, breakfast; single-origin coffee.
sla-active-0340-26-150067.angle: Allen Brothers beef for 'Mixed Meats' and burgers, specialty seafood for the Octopus Canoa, Grand Reserve butter, Spiletto olive oil and imported cheeses for Mediterranean mezze.

sla-active-0340-24-100009.summary: 2011 Albany Post Road is Yuka's Latin Fusion, an established Latin-American restaurant in Croton-on-Hudson (330+ Yelp reviews). Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0340-24-100009.style: Contemporary Latin fusion; tapas, tacos, ceviches, paella, full bar.
sla-active-0340-24-100009.menu: Bavette carne asada, ropa vieja, short rib, quesabirria, pollo asado, roasted pork shank; heavy seafood (shrimp, salmon, octopus, calamari, mahi, mussels, clams, ceviches, paella); tacos, empanadas.
sla-active-0340-24-100009.angle: Specialty seafood (octopus, calamari, mussels, clams, mahi) for ceviches and paella; Allen Brothers beef for carne asada, ropa vieja, short-rib/quesabirria; Spiletto olive oil for tapas.

sla-active-0340-22-107123.summary: Blue Hill at Stone Barns - world-renowned fine-dining restaurant (opened 2004) led by chef Dan Barber, Pocantico Hills/Tarrytown. Two Michelin stars, James Beard Award. An established institution renewing, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-107123.style: Farm-to-table New American fine dining; multi-hour no-menu seasonal tasting driven by the day's harvest.
sla-active-0340-22-107123.menu: No printed menu; multi-course seasonal tasting around farm vegetables, house-made dairy, heritage grains, regional meats.
sla-active-0340-22-107123.angle: Premium supplemental sourcing (not a produce takeover): Grand Reserve butter and artisan cheeses to complement their dairy, Allen Brothers beef and specialty seafood for protein courses, Valrhona/Chicoa and Caputo 00 for pastry; lead with provenance to match their ethos.

sla-active-0340-22-109978.summary: 75 Cooley St, Pleasantville is Chatterbox Restaurant & Bar, an established Italian-American restaurant (owner Joe Pandolfo), with a 2nd location in Hawthorne. License renewal likely.
sla-active-0340-22-109978.style: Traditional Italian-American with modern flair; lively bar, themed brunches, catering.
sla-active-0340-22-109978.menu: Chicken Scarpariello, linguine with shrimp and mussels, rigatoni pink vodka, ragu pappardelle, pizza, bacon cheeseburgers, Chocolate Lava Cake, Tres Leches.
sla-active-0340-22-109978.angle: Caputo 00 flour and Teo tomatoes for pizza/red sauces, Spiletto olive oil, imported Parmigiano/Pecorino, specialty seafood (shrimp/mussels) for frutti di mare; Allen Brothers beef upgrades the burger; Valrhona for lava cake.

sla-active-0340-22-113922.summary: 391 Old Post Rd, Bedford is TRUCK Restaurant, an established casual spot serving Northern New Mexican cuisine (chef/owner Nancy Allen Roper). Not new; a renewal.
sla-active-0340-22-113922.style: Northern New Mexican / Tex-Mex comfort food; farm-to-fork, casual.
sla-active-0340-22-113922.menu: Tacos (Chicken Tinga, Carne Adovada), Santa Fe Stacked Enchiladas, TRUCK Burger, organic soft serve, devils food cake; grass-fed beef, sustainable pork, chile sauces.
sla-active-0340-22-113922.angle: Lean into their grass-fed story: Allen Brothers beef for the TRUCK Burger and carne dishes, specialty seafood for taco specials, Grand Reserve butter and imported cheeses for enchiladas.

sla-active-0340-22-114599.summary: 'Maria Fata' is the licensee for Maria Restaurant, an established modern Italian at 11 Huguenot St, New Rochelle (opened 2019). Westchester Mag Best New Restaurant 2019, MICHELIN Bib Gourmand. Not new.
sla-active-0340-22-114599.style: Modern Italian and Italian-American; elevated classics, 14-seat quartz bar.
sla-active-0340-22-114599.menu: Housemade pastas (wild mushroom ravioli, fettuccine with lamb ragu, penne veal bolognese, gnocchi, truffle pasta), Hudson Valley mushroom risotto, grilled octopus, seafood and meat entrees.
sla-active-0340-22-114599.angle: Teo tomatoes and Spiletto olive oil for sauces/ragus, Caputo 00 flour for pasta and gnocchi, imported cheeses for pastas/risotto, Grand Reserve butter, specialty seafood for octopus/fish, Allen Brothers beef, Valrhona for dessert.

sla-active-0340-22-114349.summary: Eastchester Fish Gourmet - long-established (40+ yrs) award-winning fine-dining seafood restaurant in Scarsdale, part of the family-run Eastchester Fish Group (also a fish market). Not new.
sla-active-0340-22-114349.style: Upscale fine-dining seafood house / raw bar with on-premise fish market; Italian-influenced, plus premium steak.
sla-active-0340-22-114349.menu: Raw bar (oysters, clams, shrimp cocktail); Parmesan-crusted cod, grilled sea bass, Chilean sea bass in basil butter, soft-shell crab, whole Maine lobster, branzino; Seafood Linguine with San Marzano; saffron seafood risotto; skirt steak.
sla-active-0340-22-114349.angle: Specialty/imported seafood and Allen Brothers beef to upgrade their skirt steak; Teo tomatoes for the seafood linguine, Grand Reserve butter for signature butter sauces, Spiletto EVOO, imported Parmesan for the crusted cod.

sla-active-0340-22-110334.summary: CNG Restaurant LLC operates as Da Giorgio (Calabrese Kitchen), an established authentic Calabrese Italian restaurant in Wykagyl, New Rochelle. Chef-driven; 2025 press (Forbes). Seafood sourced daily from the family's Arthur Ave fish market. Not new.
sla-active-0340-22-110334.style: Authentic Calabrese (Southern Italian) chef-driven ristorante; fresh daily seafood, homemade pasta, ~45 seats.
sla-active-0340-22-110334.menu: Fried calamari, clams oreganata, Stuffed Meatball Calabrese; linguine Vongole, Cavatelli con le Vongole; Rigatoni Da Giorgio with filet mignon in cognac sauce.
sla-active-0340-22-110334.angle: Caputo 00 flour for house cavatelli/rigatoni, Teo tomatoes and Spiletto olive oil for Calabrese sauces, imported cheeses for antipasti, Allen Brothers beef for the filet-mignon rigatoni; CW specialty seafood for variety.

sla-active-0340-22-113756.summary: Yard House - established national chain (Darden) at Ridge Hill, Yonkers. The SLA record is a renewal. Modern American with 100+ taps and a made-from-scratch menu.
sla-active-0340-22-113756.style: Modern American gastropub / large chain; bar-forward with 100+ taps.
sla-active-0340-22-113756.menu: 100+ scratch items: burgers, street tacos, pizza, seafood, steak, poke nachos, fried mac + cheese.
sla-active-0340-22-113756.angle: Corporate chain sourcing limits a specialty distributor, but the steak/seafood program is a possible fit for Allen Brothers beef and CW seafood; pizza could use Caputo 00 flour and Teo tomatoes.

sla-active-0340-22-113399.summary: La Catena Italian Ristoranti - long-established Northern/traditional Italian fine dining (chef Emilio Delija), #1 in Ardsley on TripAdvisor. Renewal, not new.
sla-active-0340-22-113399.style: Traditional/Northern Italian fine dining; white-tablecloth, tableside preparations.
sla-active-0340-22-113399.menu: Homemade pappardelle finished tableside in a Parmigiano wheel, chicken marsala, house pastas, meat and seafood entrees, mascarpone cheesecake; Arthur Ave bread with house oil.
sla-active-0340-22-113399.angle: Grand Reserve butter and imported cheeses (Parmigiano-Reggiano wheels), Spiletto olive oil for the bread service, Caputo 00 flour for handmade pastas, Allen Brothers beef and CW seafood for entrees.

sla-active-0340-22-110345.summary: Augustine's Salumeria - acclaimed Italian salumeria/restaurant (chef Marc Taxiera) in Mamaroneck, with Michelin Guide and Hudson Valley Magazine recognition. Operating establishment; likely a renewal.
sla-active-0340-22-110345.style: Modern Italian salumeria and pasta-focused restaurant; house-cured meats and cheeses, handmade pastas; charcuterie/cheese counter.
sla-active-0340-22-110345.menu: Handmade pastas, house charcuterie and cured meats, cheese boards, locally sourced fish and seasonal produce.
sla-active-0340-22-110345.angle: Allen Brothers beef and specialty seafood, imported cheeses and Grand Reserve butter for the counter/boards, Caputo 00 flour and Teo tomatoes for pastas/sauces, Spiletto olive oil throughout.

sla-active-0340-22-113932.summary: Frankie & Fanucci's Wood Oven Pizzeria - established since Dec 2010, multiple 'Best of Westchester' wins. Renewal. Wood-fired thin-crust pizza plus handmade pastas.
sla-active-0340-22-113932.style: Wood-fired pizzeria and Italian neighborhood restaurant; charred thin-crust pies, handmade pasta, full bar; family-friendly.
sla-active-0340-22-113932.menu: Wood-oven pizzas (Margherita, Di Parma, White); pastas (fettuccine, rigatoni, cavatelli, gnocchi, ravioli); prosciutto, sausage, hanger steak; shrimp/salmon; fresh mozzarella, ricotta, burrata, stracciatella, parmigiano.
sla-active-0340-22-113932.angle: Direct pizzeria fit: Caputo 00 flour for dough and Teo tomatoes for sauce, imported cheeses (mozzarella, burrata, parmigiano), Spiletto olive oil; Allen Brothers beef for the hanger steak.
